descricao_original: A dendrite originates in the organ of Corti and extends to a bipolar, neuronal cell body located in this spiral ganglion. From the opposite pole of the cell body, an axon emerges which will join other axons to form the cochlear division of cranial nerve VIII. Ensheathing Schwann cells can also be seen accompanying both processes. 400x
